content.comment_body: Hello, I have two [product_name] [article_no] modules that control my home's lighting and switches. I rewrote all the software using UDF blocks, but it appears this feature isn't supported with [article_no]. Is there a way to convert a [article_no] project with many UDF blocks to be usable on [article_no] hardware? Thanks in advance.
Hello, According to the information in the [document], your only choices are either to manually redesign your project for [article_no] or continue using [article_no]. Regards,

analysis.insight_summary: Users experience compatibility challenges when updating or transferring projects across different versions of [product_name] hardware. In particular, software with UDF blocks made for newer [article_no] models cannot be directly transferred or converted to older [article_no] modules. This results in increased manual work and restricts flexibility for those upgrading or moving projects.
analysis.user_expectations: Users would prefer smooth compatibility or automated conversion between software for different hardware versions, especially regarding UDF blocks when migrating from newer to older [product_name] modules.
